description: Send an authenticated HTTP request to the registered Salesforce instance. Vendor permissions govern all reads, writes and deletes, including Bulk hardDelete. Supports REST, Tooling, Bulk, Apex REST and SOAP-style XML requests. Required method and relative path; optional query object, headers object and body string containing raw JSON/XML/CSV/text. Content-Type and SOAPAction belong in headers. The CLI supplies OAuth authentication; Authorization/Host overrides and CR/LF header injection are refused. No live org is needed for the hermetic tests.
embedding_description: Send authenticated Salesforce requests through the registered org CLI: REST, Tooling, Bulk, Apex REST and SOAP XML, including writes and deletes. Supply method, relative path, query, headers and raw body. A deferred job delivers HTTP status, selected headers, JSON/text body and pagination; Salesforce RBAC governs access.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Initial job_id/status queued. Completion: status (HTTP integer or null when unknown), selected headers, body, correlation_id and optional nextRecordsUrl for parsed JSON. The CLI --include printer has no delimiter: uncertain body is the ENTIRE credential-redacted printed text, with the same transcript and body_advisory. Only a recognized, non-duplicated HTTP header block plus blank separator is parsed; the explicit no-separator exception is a complete final-line JSON object/array after a valid header prefix. Every other case, including EOF after the status alone or any headers without a blank separator, unknown fields, header-like text prefixes, scalar suffixes and unseparated multiline content, preserves all printed text. The private candidate body is used only to find secrets, never as the public uncertain body. encoding_advisory discloses replacement characters and unavailable original bytes. Audit logs exclude bodies and redact query values.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: The call may have changed vendor state. A queue receipt confirms only dispatch. Report completed HTTP status/body faithfully, including vendor errors and Retry-After. Relay body_advisory/encoding_advisory when present. With an uncertain boundary, body and transcript preserve the full redacted printed output; do not drop prefixes or claim that an apparent scalar is the response. status null means no HTTP status is established. Never infer success or retry writes/deletes automatically after uncertain output. Follow nextRecordsUrl separately when returned; otherwise inspect preserved output for pagination. Original binary bytes may be unavailable.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Send a request using the registered Salesforce org credential and its vendor RBAC.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: sf.invalid_params: malformed method/path/body/header types, absolute URL or host/credential override, or CR/LF header injection. sf.auth_failed/sf.not_configured: local CLI/authentication failure without an HTTP response. Vendor 4xx/5xx remain completed HTTP response data with status, headers and body, including 412 stale-write responses and 429 rate limits. If output has no HTTP status line, status is null and the full printed body plus advisory is returned; this does not establish a vendor response or success.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Use a relative path under the registered org, set Content-Type for XML/text/JSON, and let the CLI manage credentials. Use conditional headers such as If-Match where the vendor supports them. Correct, clear, close, reopen, abort or reverse state with the appropriate vendor method/path/body; read current/history through vendor endpoints and the existing job ledger. Salesforce decides permissions and lifecycle validity. Inspect status/body before choosing any retry.
